title: Modeling Attributional Style at Scale: A Dataset and Analysis for Psychological Attribution Assessment and Reframing
abstract: arXiv:2611.26900v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: According to the reformulated Learned Helplessness theory, repeated exposure to uncontrollable negative events can foster a depressogenic attributional style, increasing susceptibility to depression yet remaining a tractable target for cognitive therapy. Computational research on attributional cognition, however, is hampered by the lack of large-scale datasets and robust evaluation protocols. In this work, we introduce the Attributional Style Transfer Dataset (ASTD) along with dedicated evaluation metrics, the first benchmark designed to model, assess, and reframe attributional explanations at scale. translated_title: 大规模归因风格建模：用于心理归因评估与重构的数据集及分析
translated_abstract: 根据习得性无助理论的修正版本，反复暴露于不可控的负面事件可能催生抑郁性归因风格，增加罹患抑郁症的易感性，但这仍是认知治疗可干预的靶点。然而，归因认知的计算研究一直受到缺乏大规模数据集和稳健评估协议的制约。在本工作中，我们提出了归因风格迁移数据集（ASTD）及配套的专门评估指标，这是首个旨在大规模建模、评估和重构归因解释的基准数据集。ASTD通过整合基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成与专家验证的“预防-过滤-验证”流程构建而成，包含42,000个真实世界事件，并配有涵盖七种风格、具有心理学依据的归因。利用该数据集，我们解决了两个关键挑战：(1) 基于监督方法的可扩展归因风格评估……
tldr: 该论文提出了首个大规模归因风格基准数据集ASTD及配套评估指标，包含42,000个真实事件和七种心理归因风格的归因标注，实现了归因风格的可扩展评估与认知重构。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ASTD, the first large-scale benchmark dataset with 42,000 real-world events and psychologically grounded attributions across seven styles, along with dedicated evaluation metrics, enabling scalable assessment and reframing of attributional style.
